title: CueMirror — a simple, fast teleprompter for iPhone and Android
description: A simple, fast teleprompter for video, live streams and presentations. Write or paste your script, press play and look at the camera. No account, no cloud, no watermark.
ogImageAlt: CueMirror logo with the line: Speak with confidence.
subtitle: A simple, fast teleprompter for video, live streams and presentations. Look at the camera, not at your notes.
badge: No account. No cloud. No watermark.
storesSoon: Coming soon to the App Store and Google Play
demoLabel: Demo: a script scrolling on the CueMirror teleprompter, with the reading line fixed in the middle of the screen.
demoScript: Hi, everyone. Thanks for being here.
Today I want to show you something simple.
Write your script, press play and keep your eyes on the camera.
The words come to you, at your own pace.
If you need a second, pause. Then pick up where you left off.
One thought at a time. One clear take.

steps.title: Write or paste
steps.text: Type your script in the app, paste it from anywhere, or dictate it with your keyboard's microphone.

steps.title: Make it yours
steps.text: Set the speed, text size, margins and colours to match the way you read.

steps.title: Read to the camera
steps.text: Press play, wait for the countdown and read with your eyes near the lens. Adjust as you go.

freeList: Script library with an editor and autosave
Dictate scripts with your keyboard's microphone
Adjustable speed, text size and margins
Text and background colours, light and dark theme
Alignment, line spacing and a reading line
premiumList: Mirrored and Flipped modes for teleprompter glass
Precise speed in words per minute and a target duration for each script
screensTitle: Made for the moment you hit record.

privacyText: No account and no cloud: the app never sends your scripts anywhere.
supportText: Write to us. If something isn't working, tell us your device model and the app version.
